name: The Starter
description: Two cards to find your feet. Everyday student spending, with a second card for changing bonus categories.
notes: For students. Discover categories require quarterly activation and share a $1,500 quarterly spending cap, then earn the base rate. Use Discover when an activated category offers more; otherwise use Savor Student. Grocery superstores are excluded. Approval is subject to each issuer.

cards.role: Your everyday card for dining, eligible groceries, entertainment and streaming.
Your quarterly specialist: use it for activated bonus categories when they beat your everyday rate.

name: Everyday Cashback
description: Three clear jobs. Everyday favourites, online shopping and gas, then everything else. No annual fees.
notes: Blue Cash Everyday has separate $6,000 annual spending caps for eligible US supermarkets, gas and online retail, then 1%. Savor grocery rewards exclude superstores such as Walmart and Target. No rotating categories to activate.

cards.role: Dining, eligible groceries, entertainment and streaming.
Eligible US online retail and gas purchases.
Other eligible purchases outside the first two cards’ bonus categories.

name: The Foodie
description: For eating in and going out. A supermarket specialist, a dining card and a simple everyday backup.
notes: Blue Cash Preferred earns its supermarket bonus on up to $6,000 of eligible US supermarket spending per year, then 1%; use Savor for eligible groceries after that cap. Selected streaming and merchant exclusions apply. The $95 ongoing fee is before any introductory waiver. For lighter grocery spending, compare Everyday Cashback.

cards.role: Eligible US supermarkets, selected streaming, US gas and transit.
Dining and entertainment, plus eligible groceries after the supermarket specialist’s cap.
Other eligible purchases, including spending outside qualifying supermarket categories.

name: The Traveler
description: Everyday spending for future trips. Broad travel categories, a catch-all and a quarterly specialist.
notes: Freedom Flex needs quarterly activation, with a shared $1,500 quarterly spending cap, then the base rate. Its categories change: use it where the current category fits, not as permanent grocery or gas coverage. Double Cash earns 1% when buying and 1% when paying. Points and cashback are shown separately, without assuming equal cash value.

cards.role: Travel, restaurants, supermarkets, gas and EV charging in its eligible bonus categories.
Other purchases outside the stack’s bonus categories; rewards include purchase and repayment components.
Activated quarterly categories that complement your regular spending; compare the reward type as well as the rate.

name: The Frequent Flyer
description: Travel benefits away. Useful spending coverage at home. Three cards for people who travel regularly.
notes: Venture X’s $300 annual travel credit requires Capital One Travel bookings; lounge enrolment and access restrictions apply. The full $395 fee is shown without subtracting credits. Blue Cash Everyday is for eligible US purchases, with separate $6,000 annual gas and online-retail caps, then 1%. Grocery exclusions apply to Savor. Cashback and miles are not treated as equal cash values.

cards.role: Travel bookings, airport benefits and everyday miles outside the other cards’ specialist categories.
Dining, eligible groceries, entertainment and streaming.
Eligible US online retail and gas at home; check foreign purchase fees before using abroad.
